gate_type: D-DAY TRACK B — BOTTLED WATER HERO LINE RUNTIME REUSE (B2 ONLY)
objective: Reuse the existing Virtual Factory discrete foundation that currently serves TIPA ASSY (src/virtual_factory/assembly/line_runtime.py + runtime controls + deterministic timing / WIP lifecycle / quality mechanics) to make the Bottled Water Filling & Packaging target line runnable, automated and deterministic. Target route: BW-FP-BLW01 -> BW-FP-RIN01 -> BW-FP-FIL01 -> BW-FP-CAP01 -> BW-FP-INS01 -> BW-FP-LAB01 -> BW-FP-CPK01 -> BW-FP-PAL01. No new simulator foundation or engine may be created.
explicit_non_objectives: No new bottled-water simulation engine / telemetry framework / scenario framework / protocol stack
No parallel runtime controller and no forked ASSY engine
No Water Treatment / Utilities / Warehouse runtime (B4)
No OEE / Availability / Performance / Quality% / energy-per-unit / utilization / health-score calculation
No PlantOS integration proof (B6) and no VPS/Docker deployment (B7)
No MQTT redesign, no PIM work, no PLC integration
No manual checklist / manual inspection result / quality disposition / release / retry / rework / operator approval workflows
No modification of TIPA ASSY semantics or the frozen B1 contracts
baseline_semantics_note: Two distinct baselines are recorded deliberately. 'expected_base_sha' is the harness baseline semantics used by preflight.py and verify_changed_files.py: the harness compares it to origin/main and diffs it against HEAD, so it must be origin/main. 'sa_expected_baseline_sha' is the SA-issued B2 baseline in Issue #102 (the frozen B1 head), which was verified equal to the branch head before the first B2 write.
allowed_paths_note: The last two entries are frozen B1 artifacts already committed on this branch by the B1 slice; they appear in the diff from origin/main and are listed only so the allowlist diff check is truthful. They are NOT authorized for modification in B2.
